notes.title: 3rd Public Showcase for Super Kingcrab Simulator! (Local Event)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636777/062d7b3903bfa306fd6a727fe16812cc1b6ca9a7.png[/img]

Hello, this is !CyberApex.
[b]We’re holding the 3rd Public Showcase for Super Kingcrab Simulator![/b]

Come experience a tastier and more powerful version of Super Kingcrab Simulator
on Sunday, June 15th.

This showcase is a special opportunity to try the final version in advance!

The venue is as follows:

[b]SOOLSOOL CENTER (Lounge Lab 2F)
15, Dorim-ro 133-gil, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul[/b]
https://naver.me/5eUPVo8n

[b]This event is a local event. (South Korea)[/b]
If you live in South Korea or are willing to visit, please refer to the following.

[i]1. Incheon Int'l Airport Terminal 1 -> Gimpo Int'l Airport Station -> Dangsan Station -> Get off at Mullae Station and walk a little.
2. If you live in Seoul, please get off at Sindorim Station and walk a little.[/i]

Please refer to Naver Map for detailed location. (If you can visit.)


See you in Mullae-dong on June 15th!
